Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with an inhibitory mechanism of action. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, and to target_dictionary on tid. Filter drug_mechanism.action_type to 'INHIBITOR'. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), and target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
